ranked.headline: Network and machine-learning models link omics profiles to cancer phenotypes
ranked.summary: Graph, network, and sparse-learning models now map multi-omics and single-cell profiles onto survival, metabolic, and drug-response phenotypes in cancer.

ranked.headline: Packaged software makes curated omics and neuroimaging data analysis-ready
ranked.summary: Processed and curated datasets are now distributed as R, Python, and Shiny tools that pair standardized metadata with analysis layers.

ranked.headline: Mathematical models of antibiotic and phage dosing for bacterial population control
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model optimal antibiotic schedules and phage-antibiotic combinations as bacterial population-level interventions.

ranked.headline: Biomedical image deep learning: reproducible evaluation and cross-cohort generalization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair open AutoML tooling and new datasets with challenge results showing top methods degrade on unseen cohorts.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models predict drug synergy, perturbation and cell-line responses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark encodings and uncertainty methods for predicting drug, cell, and gene perturbation responses.

ranked.headline: Imaging-based readouts resolve per-cell state and gene function in pooled screens
ranked.summary: Recent imaging and spatial single-cell methods extend per-cell readouts to pooled CRISPR screening, clone tracing, and spatial expression imputation.

ranked.headline: Simulations tie nucleic acid binding to surface charge and sequence features
ranked.summary: Recent MD and coarse-grained studies resolve how RNA, DNA, and nucleosome binding depend on local structural and physicochemical features.

ranked.headline: Parameter-traceable simulation links neuronal, stimulation, and brain-scale dynamics
ranked.summary: Explicit anatomical, physical, and pharmacological parameters are mapped to predicted neural output across scales, from axons to whole brains.

ranked.headline: Sampling bias and population structure distort ML antimicrobial resistance prediction
ranked.summary: Machine learning prediction of antimicrobial resistance across 24,000+ bacterial genomes is confounded by phylogenetic structure and sampling bias.

ranked.headline: Learned models score and propose ligands and fragments against defined protein targets
ranked.summary: Foundation-model priors and active-learning acquisition now combine with learned representations for affinity prediction and fragment placement.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links gene content to defense, metal uptake and lifestyle
ranked.summary: Large genome collections now resolve gene turnover, phage diversity, and metallophore capacity across bacterial and fungal lineages.

ranked.headline: Histology anchors multimodal omics integration across spatial and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Pretrained H&E foundation models are now being paired with molecular modalities in shared frameworks for spatial and single-cell integration.

ranked.headline: Reference standards and T2T assemblies sharpen variant detection accuracy
ranked.summary: Curated truth sets and complete genomes now let variant callers and alignments be quantified against defined references.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial profiling maps cell heterogeneity in embryo, bladder, and artery
ranked.summary: Spatial methylomes, isoform-resolved atlases, and perturbation screens now reach single-cell resolution within intact tissue contexts.

ranked.headline: Biological sequence foundation models add pruning, tokenization and substructure priors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test how pretraining data, tokenization and structural annotation shape nucleic acid and protein model performance.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for plate design, impedance analysis, and metabolic modeling
ranked.summary: Recent releases provide open-source tools for plate design, impedance analysis, drug-combination inference, and circadian metabolic simulation.

ranked.headline: Geometric models link epithelial shape and cell mechanics to multicellular behavior
ranked.summary: Geometric and mechanical models now quantify tissue form and infer forces or single-cell behaviors directly from morphogenesis data.

ranked.headline: Graph models encode relational topology in spatial, glycan and drug-target data
ranked.summary: Relational graph architectures now integrate multi-view, multimodal, and pretrained embeddings for spatial, glycan, and interaction prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking gene selection and transfer methods for single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method report new single-cell feature selection and transfer approaches evaluated against established alternatives.

ranked.headline: Repulsive biasing extends AlphaFold3 sampling to alternative protein conformations
ranked.summary: Generative structure predictors and physics-based simulations are being coupled to sample conformational ensembles and solvent-dependent dynamics.

ranked.headline: Excitatory-inhibitory models probe avalanche scaling and multistability in neural dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication use explicit coupled-oscillator and memory models to test how inhibition and coupling shape collective dynamics.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies tie genome architecture to biosynthetic gene content
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies of non-model fungi and plants now permit joint analysis of genome architecture and biosynthetic gene content.

ranked.headline: Admixture and structural variation shape complex-trait genetic architecture
ranked.summary: Near-complete genomes and new selection scans now let GWAS-relevant architecture be resolved in admixed and adapted populations.

ranked.headline: Held-out benchmarks and integrated predictors for biological sequence annotation
ranked.summary: Standardized partitioned splits and ensembles of existing tools are shifting ML evaluation toward held-out generalization in biological prediction.

ranked.headline: RNA-seq reads reveal cryptic and naturally variable exon splicing in human tissues
ranked.summary: Read-level sequencing signals now expose splicing variation and cryptic exons, linking transcript processing to variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: ML places active learning and computational selection inside experimental design loops
ranked.summary: ML now directs which binders, biosensor variants, and wet-lab measurements are pursued, with December 2025 studies reporting experimental validation.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic and latent-state models infer hidden treatment response dynamics
ranked.summary: Sparse or indirect measurements are driving models that encode time-dependent interactions and therapy response mechanisms explicitly.

ranked.headline: Explicit Markov state models recast Boolean and promoter regulatory dynamics
ranked.summary: Markov state representations offer parameterizable, mechanism-faithful alternatives to Hill functions and opaque Boolean attractor analysis.

ranked.headline: Host diversion and spillover risk shape arbovirus and pandemic transmission modeling
ranked.summary: Quantitative bounds on vector diversion, spillover potential, and vaccine-driven pneumococcal replacement are needed to guide surveillance and control.

ranked.headline: Ensemble and electronic-structure criteria are being used to validate structural models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method benchmark structure models against ensemble, spectral, and electronic criteria beyond single static geometries.

ranked.headline: Learned models read RNA modifications and structure from single-molecule nanopore data
ranked.summary: Direct nanopore and chemical probing readouts are now model inputs, moving RNA modification detection beyond sequence features alone.

ranked.headline: Coupling learned models to traceable biomedical evidence for omics and literature analysis
ranked.summary: Recent items pair learned models with literature and omics evidence so that outputs can be scored, grounded, and traced to their sources.

ranked.headline: Spatial indexing and GPU kernels speed structural comparison and sequence alignment
ranked.summary: Growing molecular dynamics ensembles and assembly-scale structures demand indexed, GPU-accelerated comparison and alignment tools.

ranked.headline: Resolving proteoforms and glycan structures from bottom-up mass spectrometry data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published DIA study target proteoform, glycan-structure, and proteome-depth resolution in bottom-up mass spectrometry.

ranked.headline: Tools address Hi-C segmentation, methylation imputation, and WGS/WES quality control
ranked.summary: Three December 2025 preprints release open-source software for high-dimensional genomic data, with WxS-QC also providing a public test dataset.

ranked.headline: Integrating contact mapping, RNA association and binding order in regulatory chromatin
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications link enhancer-promoter contacts, RNA-DNA contacts and single-cell factor binding order to transcriptional regulation.

ranked.headline: Learned models guide virtual screening of kinase, viral helicase, and PLK2 inhibitors
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs machine learning with iterative screening and consensus interaction models, carrying selected candidates to measured potency.
